subject: Final pass: Order Form — pricing cadence, min-commit ramp & tax/invoice routing
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmecorp.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurements@acmecorp.com
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acme — Order Form redlines and tax/invoice questions

Hi Jordan / Kimberly,

Thanks for the draft Order Form. Procurement ran a quick pass and attached a redline (Acme_OrderForm_Redlines_v3.docx). A few items we need clarity on before we can finalize: 

- Pricing bands: we want the third-tier (250k+) to kick in at 240k instead of 250k — can Redwood confirm that change is purely cosmetic or needs MSA cross-ref?
- Minimum commit ramp: our CFO prefers a 60/20/20 ramp rather than an upfront 100% commit. Is a quarterly true-up acceptable?
- Net terms: we typically require Net30 for pilots but Net45 for enterprise; can you accommodate Net45 for the first 12 months?
- Invoicing entity & VAT: we invoice to Acme US entity but may need EU VAT reverse-charge for some subsidiaries — please confirm Redwood's preferred invoicing entity and what tax evidence you need (VAT reg. number, W-8/W-9, etc.).
- PO requirement & signature: Procurements will issue a PO once commercial language is agreed; can you send a final signable Order Form (DocuSign) and confirm the order of signature (Acme first or Redwood first)?

If easier, happy to jump on a 30-min call this afternoon.

Thanks,
Alex Johnson
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corp
procurements@acmecorp.com

Attachment: Acme_OrderForm_Redlines_v3.docx (Word doc, redline)

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmecorp.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Acme — Order Form redlines and tax/invoice questions

Alex — thanks for the redline and the clear list. Quick thoughts below and next steps.

TL;DR: We can accept the pricing band tweak and the quarterly true-up for minimum commit, but net terms and invoicing entity need legal/finance sign-off. I’ve summarized the asks in the attached internal_summary.xlsx and flagged MSA cross-references for Kimberly.

Detailed replies:
- Pricing bands: Acceptable — engineering billing is unaffected. We'll update the Order Form to show 240k threshold. No hidden dependencies expected.
- Min-commit ramp: We can propose 60% upfront, then two quarterly true-ups (20% each). That reduces cash risk and aligns with your CFO ask.
- Net terms: Ben and Kimberly — can we support Net45 for the first 12 months? If not, what guardrails are required (interest on late payments, invoice disputes SLA)?
- Tax & invoicing entity: Kimberly — please advise on what evidence Acme must provide (VAT reg number, W-8/W-9, EU VAT certificate). Also confirm whether Redwood can issue invoices to Acme US and add reverse-charge handling for EU subsidiaries as a one-off.
- PO & signature: We prefer Redwood to countersign after Acme signs (standard). If Procurement insists on issuing a PO first, that’s fine; the DocuSign envelope should accommodate.

Proposed next steps:
1) Kimberly to provide suggested redline language for Net45 + late fee clause.
2) Jordan to issue an updated Order Form reflecting pricing band and min-commit ramp for signature.
3) Alex to send VAT/W-8/W-9 documents and confirm which entity will receive invoices.

If you want a call, I’m available 2:30–4:00pm PT.

—Jordan Blake
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachment: internal_summary.xlsx (spreadsheet summary)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Johnson <alex.j@acmecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Mar 2028 13:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Acme — Order Form redlines and tax/invoice questions

Jordan / Ben / Alex — looping in finance/legal position on the items below. I reviewed Acme's redline and Jordan's summary. My recommendations and proposed redline language are attached in orderform_amended_redlines.docx. Key points: 

1) Pricing band change (250k -> 240k): operationally fine, no MSA amendment required. We will update the Order Form Schedule A to reflect new breakpoints.

2) Minimum commit ramp: Accept the 60/20/20 structure subject to the following: 
   - Add clause: "Customer will provide payment for 60% of the Annual Commitment within thirty (30) days of Order Form Effective Date; remaining commitment amounts are subject to quarterly true-up invoicing. Failure to remit true-ups within forty-five (45) days will trigger suspension of service for affected routes until paid."
   - This preserves Redwood's cash protections while accommodating Acme's CFO request.

3) Net terms: We can agree to Net45 for the first 12 months provided: 
   - Net45 applies only to undisputed amounts; disputed amounts are subject to dispute process below.
   - Add limited late fee: interest at 1.25% per month on late undisputed balances after 60 days.
   - Add requirement: if payment behavior exceeds two late payments in a rolling 12-month period, Redwood may revert to Net30 with 30 days' notice.

4) Invoicing entity & VAT handling: 
   - Redwood requires a completed tax form depending on jurisdiction: W-9 for US entities, W-8BEN-E for non-US withholding exemptions, and/or a copy of local VAT registration for EU entities.
   - For reverse-charge: we can accept reverse-charge handling if Acme provides VAT registration and the specific subsidiary list to which reverse-charge applies. Invoices will still be issued to the US parent unless Acme requests subsidiary-specific invoicing (which may require an Amendment to the Order Form).

5) PO & signature flow: Accept PO-first approach. Send PO to procurement@redwood.com and we will incorporate PO number on the invoice. For signature, preferred flow is: Acme signs Order Form -> Redwood countersigns -> DocuSign completion. If Acme requires Redwood to sign first, legal can accommodate with an explicit PO acceptance clause.

I attached tracked changes and suggested language (see orderform_amended_redlines.docx). Jordan — once you accept these redlines, I can prepare the final signable Order Form (DocuSign envelope) and coordinate with Billing for invoice entity settings.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachment: orderform_amended_redlines.docx (Word doc, tracked changes)
